part1.title: Blizzard: A Night Trapped In A Stuck Ski Gondola In Flip-Flops (1/3) #shorts
part1.description:
Kai won a free ski trip. The airline lost his bag. Now he's stuck 200 feet up in a frozen gondola in shorts and flip-flops... and a man is standing on the cable, knocking on the glass.

Trust him? Part 2 is up next.
#horror #survival #scary #skiing #winter #storytime #shorts

part2.title: Blizzard: Trapped In A Gondola, The Man On The Cable Had No Rope (2/3) #shorts
part2.description:

Hold on? Part 3 is up next.

part3.title: Blizzard: Trapped In A Gondola Until Sunrise, Who Was On The Roof? (3/3) #shorts
part3.description:
Something is on the roof. The hatch is turning. Four hours until sunrise. The finale of The Last Gondola.

If a lift stops: stay inside, never climb out, rescue comes to you.
Trust him? Tell me in the comments.
